tasks.description: In contents/docs/cdp/sources/postgres.mdx, document that CDC can now be enabled, disabled, and reconfigured after source creation from the source's Configuration tab: the management-mode picker (PostHog-managed vs self-managed), prerequisite check, enable/disable actions, and editable settings (automatic slot protection / cdc_auto_drop_slot and WAL lag warning/critical thresholds). Note that disabling forces CDC schemas to pick a new sync strategy and clears CDC config so re-enabling starts clean, and that self-managed mode never touches the customer-owned publication.

In contents/docs/cdp/sources/postgres.mdx, add a section on monitoring CDC health from the Configuration tab: live replication slot and publication existence checks, WAL lag display, and what to do when the slot or publication is reported missing (recreate the publication in self-managed mode, or disable and re-enable CDC in PostHog-managed mode).

In contents/docs/cdp/sources/postgres.mdx (Operational risks and limitations), document that the primary key of a CDC schema cannot be changed once data has been synced, since the PK is the merge key for UPDATE/DELETE, and that tables discovered after source creation now persist their detected primary key so they can be switched to CDC without a manual refresh.
